title: Eliminate completed output copies with checked finite-role exchange
body:
The retained C1/B1 boundary copies a completed result from an ordinary scratch lease into its output port, then copies that port into a parent lease. This opt-in adapter exchanges ownership of the existing physical roles at those two completed boundaries, retaining dense-body validation, distinct borrowed/owned outputs, dirty leases, cleanup and the original C0/A0 bindings.

The complete handoff tariff falls from **26V + 42 to 4V + 29 physical tape operations**, saving **22V + 13** per V-symbol result with no payload writes at those boundaries and no additional tapes or numerical words. `PROOF.md` gives the finite-control role-permutation construction and full enclosing recurrence, including all unchanged native children and explicit finite-control overhead. A consumer requiring an immutable physical output port must still pay its transfer.

**Scoped implementation; no new κ.** The first complete 486-bit route drops 284,709 → 263,273 operations (7.53%). Three alternating fresh-process pairs measured 0.209s → 0.189s inside that instrumented route; process startup largely removes the wall-time gain. The fitted recursive pair saves only 22,541 out of 185,828,183 operations: its unchanged core dominates, so no material fitted runtime improvement is claimed.

Base: `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`. Package: `research/recursive-output-exchange/`; exact source closure, proof, receipts, benchmark and open obligations are retained there.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/recursive-output-exchange
```

Expected: four `PASS_RECURSIVE_OUTPUT_*` markers and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Evidence covers eight exact-tariff bodies, four complete before/after routes, a fitted pair with two actual C0 roots and all 1,024 source columns, parent numerical state, physical-inventory equality, stale-lease reuse and meaningful rejection/mutation controls. Verification environments and publication checks are recorded in VALIDATION.md. Finite execution and the written refinement argument are not a full formal multiplication theorem or a replay of the selected GL64 payload.

Current main, PRs, issues and canonical claims were refreshed. The separately active complete complex-controller implementation is outside this scope. Prior carry/compiler optimizations are neither dependencies nor combined savings. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19008205).

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR2809/2899/2915, David Arias PR2753, Nick Petalas PR2808, the fixed-role/ordinary and PR2157 factor lineage, and retained high-cube accounting work. Tekalign, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. Independent refinement/admission review remains open.
